case.why: There is no dog-walking role. A litter walk has an incidental word in common.

opportunities.title: Local history transcriber
opportunities.summary: Turn scanned handwritten letters into text for a local history collection.

opportunities.title: Community audio caption editor
opportunities.summary: Create captions for short recorded interviews to make local arts stories easier to follow.

opportunities.title: Digital drop-in helper
opportunities.summary: Show library visitors how to use a smartphone and build confidence online.

opportunities.title: Community garden buddy
opportunities.summary: Help neighbours plant vegetables and look after raised beds at a shared garden.

opportunities.title: Community kitchen cook
opportunities.summary: Prepare vegetables and cook simple meals alongside the community kitchen team.

opportunities.title: Community pantry packer
opportunities.summary: Sort donated groceries and assemble food parcels for local households.

opportunities.title: Telephone companion
opportunities.summary: Offer a friendly conversation and regular listening time to an isolated neighbour.

opportunities.title: Community poster designer
opportunities.summary: Design accessible publicity posters for local arts events using supplied text and images.

opportunities.title: Reading practice partner
opportunities.summary: Read short stories with adult learners and practise English pronunciation.

opportunities.title: Repair café assistant
opportunities.summary: Join a workbench team repairing small household items and learning simple fixes.

opportunities.title: Riverside litter walk
opportunities.summary: Keep the riverside path tidy by picking up litter with a small walking group.

opportunities.title: Seed library sorter
opportunities.summary: Label donated seed packets for the library and prepare planting information cards.

opportunities.title: Website usability tester
opportunities.summary: Try sample journeys on a charity website and write up any usability issues.

opportunities.title: Welcome desk greeter
opportunities.summary: Greet visitors at a neighbourhood centre and explain which local services run that day.

opportunities.title: Park wildlife recorder
opportunities.summary: Observe birds in a park and record a simple wildlife count alongside other volunteers.
